name: EasingFunctions
src_typeComment: Standard easing formulas. t is expected in [0, 1]; the result usually is too (Back/Elastic/Bounce overshoot on purpose). Kept as plain math, not tied to any tween engine, so it can drive UI animation, camera moves, or shader parameters.
